items.question: How is the hidden-test share rounded when the bounty times the share is not a whole number of minor units?
items.ticket: record a partial release of the configured hidden-test share (default 75%) to the contributor
items.chose: Rounds the hidden-test amount down with integer BigInt division and gives the leftover unit to the UAT part.
items.instead: Round to the nearest unit, or round the hidden-test part up.

items.question: What happens when UAT is approved before the hidden tests have passed?
items.chose: Throws an Error and records nothing.
items.instead: Release the whole bounty on UAT approval, or ignore the event without error.

items.question: What happens on a repeat hidden-tests-passed event after the release has been made?
items.chose: Returns the current state without writing, so the duplicate is silently ignored.
items.instead: Throw an error on the duplicate, or key de-duplication on the event id.

items.question: What happens on a repeat uat-approved event?
items.ticket: Remaining balance is released exactly once
items.chose: Returns the current state without writing and without error.
items.instead: Throw an error on the duplicate approval.

items.question: Is de-duplication keyed on the event id or on the release kind?
items.chose: Keys on the release kind already recorded and ignores the event id.
items.instead: Track processed event ids and ignore only events whose id has been seen.

items.question: What does a failed hidden-test run do to the stored state?
items.chose: Returns the current state, writes nothing to the store, and leaves the task open to a later passing run.
items.instead: Record the failure, or mark the task as terminally failed so a later pass is rejected.

items.question: What happens when a hidden-tests-passed event arrives after a failed run?
items.chose: Releases the hidden-test share normally, because a failure is never recorded.
items.instead: Refuse to release after a recorded failure, or require a fresh run.

items.question: What happens for a bounty of 0?
items.chose: Records zero-amount releases for both hidden-tests and uat and reports the status "pro bono".
items.instead: Record no releases at all for a zero bounty.

items.question: What happens when the share is 0%, so the hidden-test release is 0?
items.chose: Still records a hidden-tests release of amount 0, which counts as the one release and unlocks UAT.

items.question: How are invalid bounty or share values handled (negative, fractional, share above 100%)?
items.chose: Throws RangeError when the handler is created, which also covers a share outside 0–10000 basis points.
items.instead: Clamp the values, or report the error when the event is handled.

items.question: How are concurrent events for the same task handled?
items.chose: Queues events one at a time per store, so concurrent duplicates release once.
items.instead: Handle events without serialising, or rely on the store for atomicity.

items.question: What happens when the store write fails?
items.chose: Rejects with the store error and records nothing, and the queue keeps going so the event can be retried.
items.instead: Swallow the error and retry internally, or leave the queue blocked.
